name: io.github.nelsonjordanme/clypt
description: Model Context Protocol server for Clypt — submit podcast URLs, receive clips and trailer.

environmentVariables.name: CLYPT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Clypt API key. Get one at https://useclypt.com/developers. Use a clk_test_* sandbox key for free deterministic fixtures.

environmentVariables.name: CLYPT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Clypt API base URL. Defaults to https://useclypt.com.
